summary: Created docs/listing-sop.md — a phone-first admin SOP for the Airtable-as-admin workflow. Contains the ≤60s checklist (photograph → Cloudinary upload → Airtable row → 5 required fields → publish), field-by-field guidance for the 5 required fields (id, title, category, price, status) plus recommended/leave-alone fields, screenshots-in-words for the Airtable mobile grid and Cloudinary upload, common mistakes (single-select typos, duplicate ids, comma prices, deleting rows), a weekly inventory sweep routine (re-price slow movers, mark sold, refresh photos, clear expired reserved), and a note that the optional restricted-upload form is deferred (not built now). No code changes; no in-app admin form built (Airtable app is the admin). Verified: file exists, all 5 required fields enumerated, weekly sweep section present, deferred note present.
